subject: Post-call: Rebook after conflict — who should own the demo & compact agenda
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick post-call recap + two tight slots for the tech deep-dive

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the time earlier. Quick summary and next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Key need: evaluate latency/cost tradeoffs for your multi-tenant inference flows and confirm KV cache strategy for warm start times.
- Success criteria (what you asked us to validate): 95th percentile response under 1200ms for short prompts, predictable cost per 1k tokens under target, and a path for on-prem privacy controls.
- Action: schedule a compact technical deep-dive (30m) with our SE and AM to walk architecture and run through a short checklist.

I had two tight windows this week that are still open — can you pick one? If neither works, we’ll propose a single additional option tomorrow and lock it down.

Option A: Thu 2026-10-28 10:00–10:30 PT
Option B: Fri 2026-10-29 14:00–14:30 PT

Also: quick ask — who on your side should own the demo? We find it helps if the customer picks a single technical owner and one procurement/ops attendee so we can tailor the agenda. If you confirm ownership, Marissa (SE) will lead the architecture walkthrough and Ben (AM) will cover pricing/next steps.

Attaching a compact agenda and a one-page mutual action plan to keep the call tight. If you’re able to confirm within 24 hours we’ll lock the slot.

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v1.pdf, BRP-MAP-v0.3.xlsx
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightpath.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-24T10:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + two tight slots for the tech deep-dive

Hi Karthik —

Sorry — I had an overlapping ops escalation and missed the earlier invite. Thanks for the clear recap.

Both slots you proposed are close; I can do Option B (Fri 10/29 14:00 PT) but only if we keep it strictly to 30 minutes. I need our infra lead (Aaron Park) on the call; he may hop on for the architecture portion then drop. There’s also a procurement person who wants to be looped in after the technical confirmation — provisioning@brightpath.ai (cc’d in our side thread).

On ownership: I’ll be the exec sponsor, Aaron will be the technical owner for follow-ups. For the live demo, we prefer Redwood to lead the walkthrough (Marissa), and I’ll moderate from BrightPath.

Confirming Option B tentatively — can you send a calendar invite with the compact agenda and a short list of items we’ll validate live?

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Product | BrightPath AI
Samantha Lee <samantha@brightpath.ai>
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-24T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + two tight slots for the tech deep-dive

Thanks Samantha — good to know Aaron will join for the infra piece. Confirming we’ll keep the session to 30 minutes and stick to the compact agenda. I’m locking Option B tentatively on our side pending your calendar acceptance.

Proposed compact agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: intros & success criteria confirmation (Karthik / Samantha)
- 5–18m: SE architecture walkthrough + KV cache questions (Marissa + Aaron)
- 18–26m: performance profile and pricing levers (Ben)
- 26–30m: concrete next steps & mutual action plan (Karthik)

Two operational asks so this meeting is as actionable as possible:
1) Please confirm Aaron Park (aaron@brightpath.ai) and the procurement contact who should receive the MAP (procurement@brightpath.ai).
2) If you want Redwood to do any quick end-to-end test inputs in-call, share a small, sanitized prompt set (3–5 examples) ahead of time.

I’ve attached the MAP and agenda again, and I’ll send a calendar invite for Fri 10/29 14:00–14:30 PT. If anything changes on your side before EOD tomorrow, please reply and we’ll re-open a single backup slot.

—
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: BRP-MAP-v0.3.xlsx
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightpath.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Park <aaron@brightpath.ai>, procurement@brightpath.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + two tight slots for the tech deep-dive

Hi Karthik —

Confirmed — Fri 10/29 14:00–14:30 PT works and I accepted the calendar invite. Aaron and procurement are both looped in now. We want Redwood to own the demo; Marissa leading the architecture walkthrough sounds great.

I attached a short sanitized prompt set in my calendar reply (three prompts) — hope that helps for the in-call checks. See you Friday.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product | BrightPath AI
